long_description:
## The world is a lot right now. This is time to slow down, support our nervous systems, and practice co-regulation together in community.

Chair Yoga offers a gentle, accessible chair-based movement and meditation practice. Using chairs for support, we’ll move slowly, breathe together, and take time to settle — no mats, no experience, no expectations.

Chairs are provided; All abilities are welcome and encouraged to join. Yoga mats are NOT necessary!

The entire practice can take place seated on the chair, with a few options for using the chair for balance in standing variations of poses.

While this is a public class and not specifically an LGBTQ+ event, you'll be supported by a queer yoga teacher <3

This class will be led by elle brodsky, founder of Rainbow Fit Club and certified yoga teacher since 2008.

description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. Registration is open for our fall HEALING WITH MANTRAS kirtan retreat at @kripalucenter October 9 - 12, 2026. These dates fill up quickly (it's Indigenous People's Day /Columbus Day weekend!) so reserve your spots early! 

In this program, we'll learn and practice healing mantras from the Tibetan Buddhist and Tibetan medical traditions and experience their effects on our minds, our chakras, our hearts, and the energy channels of the subtle body.

📿 In the mornings, we'll practice simple mantra recitation (speech-level spoken chants) and silent chanting (inner-voice chanting) to activate healing energies and quell inner and secret obstacles. 

🎶 In the afternoons and select evenings, we'll practice kirtan (call-and-response chanting) and sing devotional mantras from the Buddhist and Hindu traditions.

This retreat is an opportunity to learn and practice deep rest and deep self-care. 

You will:

- learn how to use your own voice and sound currents to heal your own body, voice, and mind. 💫

- immerse in the profound beauty of the Kripalu campus, nestled in the Berkshire Mountains, and enjoy trail hikes, boating, and guided outdoor activities at peak foliage season. And nature, as we know, is good medicine. 🌈

- Enjoy world-class food (based on Ayurvedic principles), Ayurvedic spa treatments, and a wide array of yoga/meditation/dance/art classes to choose from. 🔥

- enjoy the company of supportive and like-minded community who are committed to being of benefit to all beings 

- Receive guidance and instruction for home practice.

description: Experience the Vibrancy of Bengali Culture at Rishi Panda Live Concert & PBA Durga pujo 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Bengali Culture at Rishi Panda Live Concert & PBA Durga pujo 2026
Mark your calendars for the 11th of October, 2026, as the Rishi Panda Live Concert & PBA Durga Pujo 2026 in NJ is set to make waves. Hosted by the Princeton Bengali Association (princetonbengalees), this anticipated event will be a marvelous blend of music, spirituality, food, and drink. Immerse yourself in the multilingual performances, witness the vibrancy of Bengali and Hindi cultural traditions, and enjoy a live concert that is sure to leave you spellbound.
Unveiling the Talent of Rishi Panda
At the heart of this event is the acclaimed independent artist, Rishi Panda. From his humble beginnings as a young music enthusiast, Rishi has grown into a popular YouTuber and singer. His partnership with JMR Music has given birth to a plethora of captivating original and cover songs. Known for his soul-stirring performances, Rishi Panda will undoubtedly enchant the audience at this concert.
Discover the Charm of Community Middle School
The event will take place at the well-known Community Middle School, located at 95 Grovers Mill Rd, in the picturesque city of Plainsboro, NJ, United States. The venue is known for its safety and easy accessibility, enhancing the overall experience for attendees. Additionally, the area boasts numerous Indian restaurants for those looking to indulge in authentic Indian cuisine after the event. Parking facilities will also be available at the venue, ensuring convenience for all attendees.
Choose Your Perfect Ticket
Various ticket options are available to cater to your needs. For adults over 12 years, non-veg and veg options are priced at $65.00. For kids aged between 5 and 12 years, comprehensive tickets are available at $55.00. For those who wish to attend only the Rishi Panda show, tickets for adults are priced at $50.00, and for kids, at $45.00. Children below 5 years can enjoy the event at no cost. Secure your spot today to experience an unforgettable celebration of Bengali culture and music.

About this Event

I bet you haven’t laughed like this in months and will feel lighter afterward!
Join us for a fun and rejuvenating session of Laughter Yoga at the Shelley Lake Fishing Pier's top seating area! This event is all about spreading positivity and laughter through simple scream therapy, deep breathing exercises, Laughter Yoga, clapping, stomping, shaking, and playful activities. No yoga mat is needed, and no experience is required.
Bring an open mind and a willingness to laugh! We will have a play session for 35 minutes and then chat while we walk around Shelley Lake. Every part of the excursion is optional.
Join the So Laugh Tribe to laugh, de-stress, and enjoy the great outdoors.

Wear athletic clothes and shoes, and bring water if needed.What's included:
20 Restorative Play Sessions at Shelley Lake during the 2026 season.

title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Voices for Parkinson's
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit. Voices For Parkinson's provides in-person and telehealth speech therapy services for residents of Ohio. Individual, 1:1 services are currently provided at Alpha Neuro Fitness (800 E Ross Ave) in Cincinnati, OH. Weekly speech maintenance groups are offered via a hybrid approach, with the option for virtual and/or in-person attendance. The nonprofit organization offers a whole-person approach to treating the symptoms of Parkinson's disease, relating to problems with cognition, voice, and swallowing. We offer resources and education, and collaborate with an interdisciplinary team including local businesses to provide the most up-to-date information to our clients and their community.
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

Light Up the Night at Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night by Pancham Beats
Mark your calendars for the 15th of October, 2026, as Pancham Beats LLC brings you an unforgettable night of celebration and dance at the Navratri 2026 - Live Garba and Dandiya Night. Experience the joy of Navratri, one of the most vibrant festivals celebrated with great fervor and enthusiasm. long_description:
Fall Yoga Retreat: A Refuge for Your Heart

October 16-18, 2026

with Chaya Spencer at Lifebridge Sanctuary, Rosendale, NY

A true refuge is more than a place. It is a space where the mind grows quiet, the body softens, and the heart feels safe. It is where we can set down the weight of daily responsibilities, reconnect with what matters most, and remember the steady center that lives within us. In times of challenge, refuge restores us. In times of ease, it deepens our connection to ourselves and to one another.

Join us for a nourishing weekend retreat at Lifebridge Sanctuary, nestled in the beauty of the Catskills. Through yoga, meditation, time in nature, wholesome meals, meaningful conversation, and spacious periods of rest and reflection, you’ll be invited to slow down and settle into a deeper sense of presence and belonging.

In the yogic tradition, there is a beautiful Sanskrit phrase: hridaya vishranti—reposing in the heart. Here, “heart” does not refer to the physical organ or even the emotional heart, but to our essential nature, the innermost core of who we are. Vishranti means rest, repose, or deep relaxation. Together, these words point to the experience of resting in our own being, returning home to ourselves.

This retreat offers a supportive cocoon for renewal and self-discovery. Come away for a weekend of rest, connection, and renewal. Return home grounded, refreshed, and reconnected to the essence of who you are.

Our retreat center, Lifebridge Sanctuary, offers us a space of peace, nature and quiet to introspect, practice yoga, eat well and rest in beauty inside and out. The Sanctuary is a 12,000 square foot hand crafted, green facility on 95 acres of forest and spectacular open space on the Northern crest of the Shawangunk Ridge, less than 90 minutes from Shree.

description: REZN
long_description:
REZN – the Chicago-based band of Rob McWilliams (vocals, guitar), Phil Cangelosi (bass), Patrick Dunn (drums), and Spencer Ouellette (synth/saxophone) – announce their new album, Burden, out June 14th via their new label Sargent House. In conjunction, they present its massive lead single/video, “Chasm.” Since their inception, REZN have mined the stark monochromatic depths of underground metal and fused them with the kaleidoscopic delights of psychedelia, prog rock, and shoegaze. With their latest album Burden, they plumb the deepest, bleakest trenches of their sound while retaining a lifeline into the cosmos. Staking a claim at the crossroads of the hazy dimensions of modern psych acts like Black Angels, the cavernous gloom and reverb-drenched guitar of bands like Spectral Voice, and the lurching low-end meditations of artists like OM, REZN have created Burden—an album of immense amp-worshipping weight and intoxicating instrumentation.

Burden was recorded simultaneously with their previous album Solace back in July 2021 at Earth Analog Studios in Tolono, IL by Matt Russell. Rather than release a double album, REZN divided the material into two separate records, each with its own distinct emotional timbre. Whereas Solace was meant to uplift and create a sense of narcotic dreaminess, Burden skews towards the themes of delirium, claustrophobia, and misery. Musically, Burden favors riffs over atmosphere, percussion over ether, dissonance over beauty, but there is still an undeniable cohesion between it and its predecessor. The marriage of brute force and sublime textures has always been a key tactic in REZN’s approach—a duality that may explain their touring history with fellow synesthesia-inducing metallurgists Elder and Russian Circles—but the spectrum of the band’s mercurial temperaments has never felt as clearly defined and fully explored as it does on Burden.

title: Trauma Informed Yoga Teacher Training
venue_name: Pilgrimage of the Heart Yoga - Normal Heights
description: Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
long_description:
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.

About this Event

Trauma is an emotional response to a stressful or disturbing incident or physical injury. When one experiences a traumatic event, it can create an inner environment that will affect many aspects of the survivor’s life. From a sense of disconnection to a dysregulated nervous system, the impact of trauma reaches both the mind and the body and can leave one with feelings of insecurity, overwhelm and powerlessness that can distance the survivor from their innate sense of joy and inner peace.
Yoga has many tools that can reconnect practitioners to their inner peace and well-being, but for those living with the inner wound of trauma, a regular yoga class may present challenges that keep them from enjoying the many benefits of the practice.
Trauma informed yoga aims to create a welcoming space for anyone who is experiencing the difficulties that can result from traumatic events.
Join Lauren McLaren to investigate the impact of trauma and explore how to make your classes inclusive and sensitive to the needs of those who are living with the effects of trauma.
During this 14-hour training, you will learn:
How trauma can affect physical health and well-beingThe neurobiology of trauma and how yoga can assist in regulating the nervous system to help reconnect the body/mind systemsHow to use practices including asana, pranayama, mudra and mindfulness to promote empowerment and agencyHow to honor trauma survivors in yoga classes by tailoring language and cues, providing consistency in structure, and offering modificationsThis training is perfect for teachers who want to create a more inclusive teaching environment as well as for practitioners who are looking to advance their knowledge in how yogic tools can serve this population.
Please note that this training is not intended to empower teachers to diagnose or treat trauma

His seven albums have received critical acclaim from O, The Oprah Magazine, Yoga Journal, and The Guardian, among others. The fourth full-length from Basement, Beside Myself is an intimate look at the drawbacks of living in your own head, and the attempt to shake off everyday anxieties. “One of the things everyone in the band seems to struggle with is living fully in the present time,” says Andrew Fisher, who co-founded the Ipswich, England-bred five-piece in 2010. “We tend to look back on the past and think, ‘That was so much better than what’s going on now,’ or look toward the future and assume it’s going to be better than today. The title came from thinking about, ‘Wouldn’t it be great if you could stop yourself from doing that, and just appreciate the moment as it happens?’” 

But for all its intense introspection and confessions of self-consciousness, Beside Myself centers on a powerful, passionately charged sound that makes every track feel deeply cathartic. A relentless burst of pure vitality, the album expresses its unrest in the language of furious guitar riffs and visceral rhythms. And at the heart of Beside Myself are Basement’s indelible melodies, an element that lends an anthemic quality to even the most heavy-hearted songs. 

The follow-up to Promise Everything—a 2016 album whose re-release the following year marked Basement’s debut for Fueled by Ramen—Beside Myself was co-produced by the band and Colin Brittain, and mixed by Rich Costey (Arctic Monkeys, Foo Fighters, Muse). About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events2/banners/dcb6ced0-87e3-11f1-b6c8-ef4137d8dcb0-rimg-w663-h740-dca7c3f1-gmir.jpg 

YOU are invited to GOAT YOGA in BEDFORD, TX! Come and get your yoga on while our tribe of pet goats graze and jump around (or on) you! We will be in the pumpkin patch at the Bedford Public Library! Come as you are or dressed up in Halloween costume attire. The goats will be in costume!
Please come dressed for the weather as the event will be outside. Proceeds from this class directly benefit our animals and our local non-profit initiatives. 

Know before you go:
*Please do not enter the fenced off goat yoga area any earlier than 15 minutes before your scheduled class time. We will set aside time after class for extra socializing and picture taking with the goats if you don't get the shot you want during yoga practice.
 *BYOM (bring your own yoga mat) We do not provide mats, but we do provide beach towels for all attendees to use. We also provide bottled waters, sunscreen, bug spray, etc.
*Be prepared for our goats to take an interest in you! They are excited to be with you! Goat yoga is for everyone, and we welcome participants age 5 and over (with a participating parent or guardian). It is meant to be fun and memorable. Goats have been known to nudge, scratch, nibble, jump and step on attendees. Goats are NOT potty trained animals. There will be a sanitizing station and antibacterial wipes available.
*Everyone will need to check in and sign our liability waiver before the class starts. Masks are not required. This is an outdoor fitness event. Social distancing will be the responsibility of each participant in regards to their own preferences in proximity to other attendees.

Our tribe looks forward to meeting you!

Let us know if you have any questions or if we can provide you with any additional information - we look forward to hosting you!

title: Marine Corps Marathon 2026 — The People's Marathon
description: The third-largest US marathon and world's largest with no prize money. Run past DC's monuments with Marines cheering you on.
long_description: Known as 'The People's Marathon,' the Marine Corps Marathon is the third-largest marathon in the US and the world's largest without prize money. The 51st edition takes runners on a spectacular tour of Washington DC — past the Pentagon, along the Potomac, through Georgetown, around the National Mall, and past the Capitol. US Marines manage every mile, handing out hydration, cheering runners on, and placing finisher medals. The emotional 'wear blue: run to remember' mile honors fallen service members. Registration opens April 6.
venue_info: Start: Pentagon parking lot, Arlington, VA. Finish: Marine Corps War Memorial (Iwo Jima). Metro (Pentagon station, Blue/Yellow lines) is the best way to get there. Health & Fitness Expo at the National Building Museum. 6-hour time limit.

title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. About this Event

Full Hunter's Moon Goat Yoga
Monday October 26, 2026 from 6:00 to 7:00.
What better way to end your day? Join us at Chip-In Farm for a Full Harvest Moon Goat Yoga class featuring our herd of friendly baby goats! Goat kids are naturally curious and playful, and our little goats love to cuddle.
While this may not be the most meditative and relaxing yoga class you've ever been to, it will surely be the most memorable - perfect for melting that stress away!
The class is suitable for all levels of yoga experience and taught by a Ceritfied Yoga Instructor.
Bring your own mat, blanket, or towel but be prepared for the goats to potentially taste test everything!
We recommend towels for easy cleaning. The yoga class will take place outside in the evening so bring layers in case of colder weather.
$30.00 class fee per person includes 1 hour of yoga instruction with time to pet, hold, and take pictures with the goats.

description: Body & Soul Art Intensive with Alex Grey & Allyson Grey
long_description:
ABOUT THE PROGRAM

Body & Soul Art Intensive is a creative spiritual practice and visionary ritual intended to turn on the Light Body. Multiple systems of subtle healing life energies run through and surround our body. Seven Chakras, witnessed and reported by clairvoyants as "wheels of light,” ascend the spine and color our emotions and aspirations.

This drawing ritual challenges us to depict the model’s nude presence and encourages us to imagine and portray bio-energetic radiant auras that extend beyond the skin.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Drawing begins on the first morning of the workshop. Each of the seven chakra drawings are briefly introduced by a short guided meditation to consider the energetic force-field associated with the chakra we are about to portray. 

Each participant will create seven drawings focusing on the character and hue of one chakra. Each drawing period is forty-five minutes long, working with meditative focus. The exercise is accompanied by a thematic musical playlist highlighting the archetypal meaning of each chakra. 

To introduce each drawing, a brief blessing describes the meaning, color and vibration of that energy center, identifying specific organs and nerve bundles that correspond within the body. The subject of each drawing is a yogini, a nude model who stands, sits or lies still for class members to draw or paint. 

YOUR INSTRUCTORS

Alex Grey & Allyson Grey

Alex Grey, world-renowned artist, poet, and author, is best loved for his paintings which portray multiple dimensions of reality, interweaving biological anatomy with psychic and spiritual energies. His books, Sacred Mirrors, The Mission of Art, Transfigurations, and Art Psalms, trace the development of his work and mystical experiences that shaped his spiritual artistic life. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? title: Gentle Yoga & iRest Yoga Nidra – Community Class
description: Gentle Yoga & iRest Yoga Nidra – Community Class Gentle yoga & iRest yoga nidra for relaxation, mindfulness, and restorative flow – open to all levels. Every third Thursday. Hi, my name is Ashley. I’m a yoga instructor based in San Diego, and I’m excited to offer community classes as a way to expand my offerings and create space for connection. This gentle yoga class blends slow, mindful movement with iRest Yoga Nidra, a guided deep relaxation practice. These sessions are designed to help you unwind, restore energy, and cultivate presence, all while staying connected to breath and body. Expect 75 minutes of restorative flow, with modifications offered for all levels. My intention is to create a welcoming, supportive environment where you can slow down, release tension, and leave feeling calm, grounded, and rejuvenated. Schedule: Classes are held every third Thursday of the month, 9:30–10:45 AM at VibrantLife Center. Each session is an individual class, so you can register for one or multiple dates that work for you. title: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening
description: Path to Enlightenment: Live Bhagavad Gita Classes for Spiritual Awakening Classes will guide you through complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual wisdom. An ongoing in-depth course deliving into profound wisdom within Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Hindu/Indian/Vedic spiritual philosophy, and Upanishads. You can see prior recordings at: YesVedanta.com/bg2 Timeless Wisdom of Bhagavad Gita: A Complete Course in Non-Duality in 700 Verses Join us for an in-depth exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, a foundational text of Vedantic wisdom. Our weekly live Zoom classes will guide you through the complexities of life and reveal your true nature through the highest spiritual knowledge. The Bhagavad Gita, a dialogue between Krishna (the teacher) and Arjuna (the student), addresses life's deepest questions: What is the nature of the Self? What is the highest purpose of existence? How can one live with intelligence and clarity? If all existence is One, why do we perceive differences? What is the nature of the universe and its origin? How can we understand the cause of the universe? How does one transcend the sense of limitation? This comprehensive study covers: The nature of the Self (Atman) and Reality (Brahman) Self-knowledge that includes dozens of methods to reveal your nature The role of karma, dharma, and free will The nature of the mind and consciousness (or awareness) The art of wise living and decision-making Cultivating emotional maturity and inner peace Through this course, you will: Grasp the core teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and their relevance to modern life Apply practical techniques for refining your thinking and mastering your emotions Develop a deeper understanding of your identity and the world Cultivate inner peace, clarity, and purpose This knowledge offers a step-by-step method to liberate the seeker from the confines of the ego, from the limitations imposed by the material world, and from the cycle of rebirth. Florida Bollywood Events 2026 (Wholesaleprinted) invites you to set sail on the Bollywood Diwali Cruise 2026. On the 27th of November, 2026, we will be celebrating the Festival of Lights in true Bollywood style. This unique fusion of Hindi, English, and multilingual music, dance, and food & drink promises a night to remember. Immerse yourself in the rhythmic beats of Bollywood music, the vibrant energy of dance performances, and the festive spirit of Diwali - all while cruising through the beautiful Port Miami.
Artistic Enthrallment on the High Seas
While the artist for the Bollywood Diwali Cruise 2026 has yet to be announced, rest assured that the performer will captivate you with their talent. As per tradition with our events, the artist will be a maestro in their field, providing an unforgettable experience that perfectly complements the festive atmosphere of Diwali. Stay tuned for further updates!
Setting Sail from Picture-Perfect Port Miami
Our Bollywood Diwali Cruise 2026 departs from Port Miami, located at 1015 North America Way, Miami, FL, United States. Known as the 'Cruise Capital of the World', Port Miami is renowned for its safety and accessibility. Parking is available at the venue, so you can arrive at your convenience. While you're in the area, we recommend exploring the local Indian restaurants - a perfect way to begin your Bollywood Diwali Cruise experience.
Embark on Your Diwali Adventure with General Admission Tickets
Your passage to this unforgettable event can be secured with General Admission Tickets priced at $594.00. These tickets offer a full-access experience to the Bollywood Diwali Cruise 2026, ensuring you don't miss a moment of the music, dance, and Diwali festivities. Don't wait - secure your ticket today and join us for an extraordinary celebration.

title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Give Like a Mother
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Give Like a Mother - Clothing Kids in Confidence

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit Give Like a Mother. Give Like A Mother (GLAM) is a nonprofit dedicated to ensuring that local children and teens in need have access to seasonally appropriate clothing.
Though we operate on donations of gently used items, we are committed to providing high-quality, in-style clothing that kids can wear with confidence. When children feel good about what they’re wearing, it can boost their self-worth, reduce the risk of ridicule, and ultimately support their success in school and beyond.
Our name may be fun and a little sassy, but it carries a serious challenge. Mothers give everything they can for their children—yet sometimes, even that isn’t enough.
That’s why we’re asking you: Will you Give Like A Mother and help a child in need?
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

long_description:
Recalibrate with a cozy candlelit sound bath with hot Cacao, opening the heart and welcoming in quiet rest and simplicity during the season.

About this Event

New Moon Sound Bath with Freqs of Love @ Blosm Studio

Join us at blosm studio for a hot cacao ceremony, and get cozy for the season with a high-vibrational journey into stillness. You will be held through sound created by sacred instruments (Including an array of deep-resonance gongs, drums, crystal singing bowls, and ethereal chimes) in a 60-minute, powerful high-frequency reset sound bath for the Scorpio New Moon.
Through Freqs of Love's curated set of instruments and vocal toning, deep frequencies help entrain the brain and field, moving you from a state of overwhelm or exhaustion into an effortlessly deep, meditative Theta state. The mind moves into parasympathetic mode where the body can do its best healing.
We honor this season of dark by bringing in heart-opening intentions, twinkling candlelight, and sweet intentions for connection, community, peace, and warmth. Join us for a relaxing evening centered on nurturing you!

What to expect
Deep relaxation, intentions led with heart, and a sound journey unlike any other to center, ground, clear, and charge your energy for the month ahead. Bring a friend and settle in for a serious recalibration.

Yoga mats, bolsters, blankets, and water will be provided, but bring whatever props will help you get the most cozy.
No prior experience with sound baths needed, first-timers welcome!Doors open at 6:45pmStarts at 7:00pmDuration ~60 minutes with safe space share afterwardFree parking in lot availableAges 14+

description:
Join Susanna Barkataki for this Friday night class! A coming home to your own body, breath, and belonging  grounded in the ancient roots of the practice and the wisdom of trauma-informed teaching.

We begin where yoga has always begun: with sound. With gentle movement, slow shapes, philosophy and br
long_description:
Join Susanna Barkataki for this Friday night class! A coming home to your own body, breath, and belonging grounded in the ancient roots of the practice and the wisdom of trauma-informed teaching.

We begin where yoga has always begun: with sound. With gentle movement, slow shapes, philosophy and breath.

Rooted in the tradition's own understanding that the nervous system is sacred, and the body is not something to push through but something to listen to, Susanna Barkataki guides you through an accessible, embodied practice that weaves pranayama, gentle movement, mantra, and meditation into a single living experience.

This is yoga as the tradition always intended it, a path toward wholeness for every body.

You will leave feeling grounded, held, and more at home in yourself than when you walked in. 

Early bird pricing available until 10/31/26.

title: BMW Dallas Marathon 2026
description: Dallas's premier marathon weekend with full marathon, half, ultra, 5K, and relay options. Benefits Scottish Rite for Children.
long_description: The BMW Dallas Marathon has been a Texas running tradition for over 40 years. The race weekend features a full marathon, half marathon, ultra marathon, 5-person relay, 10K, and 5K — something for every runner. The course starts at Dallas City Hall, loops through scenic White Rock Lake, and finishes back downtown. Since 1997, the marathon has donated nearly $5 million to Scottish Rite for Children. The December timing provides cool running weather, and the event has sold out three consecutive years.
venue_info: Start/finish at Dallas City Hall, 1500 Marilla St. The course is flat and fast, passing through downtown Dallas and around White Rock Lake (120m total elevation gain). DART light rail serves the City Hall area. Post-race party with food, beer, and live music.

long_description:
Dive into Winter Solstice magic with Tej Ray! Candlelit music, Yoga Nidra, breathwork sound healing for deep renewal. Join the enchantment!

About this Event

The Winter Solstice marks the longest night of the year—a sacred turning point where we pause, exhale, and return to the quiet center within. It is a time of stillness, dreaming, and deep restoration.
Join Tej and Ray for a candlelit journey into the heart of winter. Through original music, guided Yoga Nidra, breathwork, and immersive sound healing, you’ll be held in a space of warmth, wonder, and renewal.
The Journey Includes:
🌅 Original songs by Ray to open and close the ceremony
💫 Seasonal astrology update + guided Yoga Nidra by Tej
🎶 Live music, poetry, and moments of deep stillness
🌬 Breathwork to soothe the nervous system and settle the body
🌀 Meditation journey with kaleidoscope visuals, crystal bowls, djembe, and gong
🎼 Full sound healing immersion while resting in stillness
🌙 Closing intention ritual and shared resonance to carry forward
🧺 What to Bring:
Yoga mat + cozy layers
Blanket, bolster, pillow, or anything for deep comfort
Optional eye cover or journal
Water bottle
Pre-registration encouraged | Space is limited

description: Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrance of Tamil Culture at the San Diego Tamil Sangam Annual Membership 2026
Mark your calendars for December 31st, 2026, as on this day, the San Diego Tamil Sangam will host its highly anticipated Annual Membership event. A cultural extravaganza that celebrates the richness and diversity of Tamil heritage, this event is a golden opportunity for Tamil enthusiasts to come together and revel in the vibrancy of this ancient culture. The event is sure to be a hub of engagement, enrichment, and entertainment that fosters the promotion and preservation of Tamil language, arts, and literature.
Artist: A Secret Yet to be Revealed
The event is yet to announce its artist, but it's known for featuring renowned individuals from the Tamil community who have significantly influenced the preservation and promotion of Tamil culture. The mystery guest, no doubt, will offer a memorable experience, showcasing the beauty of Tamil arts and literature that resonates with the audience and deepens their appreciation for this rich culture.
Immerse Yourself in Tamil Culture in the Heart of San Diego
The event takes place in San Diego, California, specifically at the 750 B Street location. The venue is in an easily accessible area of the city, known for its safety and proximity to a variety of attractions. After the event, guests can explore the city's vibrant nightlife, historical landmarks, and breathtaking beaches. And for those craving authentic Indian cuisine, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby where you can indulge in a variety of flavorful dishes.
Secure Your Membership: Ticket Information
Various membership options are available for purchase, ensuring there's something for everyone. The Annual Family Membership is priced at $60.00, providing an excellent opportunity for families to be part of the Tamil community in San Diego. The Annual Individual Membership is available for $35.00, perfect for individuals passionate about Tamil culture. Additionally, the Student Membership from India is priced at a discounted rate of $10.00. For those who want to make a long-term commitment, the Lifetime Membership is available for $500.00. Make sure to secure your membership and be part of the San Diego Tamil Sangam's thriving community.

long_description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City. He is currently a finalist on Kevin Hart’s Funny AF for Netflix, which premiered on April 20. In 2024, he made his late-night debut on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off America’s Got Talent.

As an actor, Usama has appeared in Netflix’s Inventing Anna and Survival of the Thickest, HBO’s And Just Like That, Comedy Central’s Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens, and FX’s Better Things. He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy Best of the Best, alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018. In 2020, he reached the semifinals of America’s Got Talent and appeared in the ABC Discovers Talent Showcase. A decorated festival performer, he was a finalist in the 2017 New York’s Funniest competition at Caroline’s and the NBC Stand-Up competition, and has won top honors at the Laughing Devil Cup Comedy Festival (2016), Yonkers Comedy Festival (2015), and Make Me Laugh Albany Comedy Festival (2015). His work has also been featured by NBC, BuzzFeed, Refinery29, The Scene, Mic.com, FusionTV, and The Huffington Post.
